description: Dashboard data enrichment: add more data panels to the index page and enhance existing panels for a Bloomberg-terminal feel with richer data. Add additional market data endpoints to app.py including VIX history, earnings calendar placeholder, and a crypto dashboard section. Also add portfolio value summary endpoint.
steps: In dashboard/app.py, add new endpoint GET /api/market-overview that returns the data from augur.data.fetch_market_overview() directly (if not already mapped - check if it exists). Confirm /api/hot-tickers endpoint maps to fetch_hot_tickers().
In dashboard/app.py, add GET /api/market-movers endpoint that extracts top 5 gainers and top 5 losers from the hot_tickers data (sort by change_pct).
In dashboard/app.py, add GET /api/crypto-overview endpoint that returns BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, XRP prices and 24h change from yfinance.
In dashboard/app.py, add GET /api/commodities endpoint that returns Gold, Silver, Oil (WTI), Natural Gas prices and changes.
In dashboard/app.py, add GET /api/treasury-rates endpoint that returns US 2Y, 5Y, 10Y, 30Y bond yields.
In dashboard/templates/index.html, add a Crypto Overview section after the existing Hot Tickers section, rendered from /api/crypto-overview.
In dashboard/templates/index.html, add a Commodities & Rates section showing gold/oil/bonds data, rendered from /api/commodities and /api/treasury-rates.
Ensure all new endpoints have proper error handling (try/except around yfinance calls, return empty arrays on failure).
Run: python3 -m pytest tests/ -x -q to confirm no regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard index page shows crypto, commodities, and treasury rate panels
All new API endpoints return valid JSON even when yfinance fails
